title: Bells in the Abyss
description: A dark surreal scene featuring a grid of black wooden beams with numerous glowing golden bells hanging from strings. The background is deep black with swirling yellow-green ethereal shapes, ghostly handprints, circular ripples, and luminous particles floating in the darkness.
prompt: Surreal dark painting of numerous glowing golden bells hanging from a grid of black wooden beams and strings, set against a deep black void with swirling yellow-green ethereal mist, ghostly luminous handprints, circular ripples emanating from the bells, and floating golden particles, mysterious and haunting atmosphere
